Valve's Steam Frame headset gets a November release date

Published 2026-10-07 12:20 UTC

Valve says its Steam Frame standalone VR headset will ship on November 12th, starting at $599 for the 256GB model and $799 for 1TB. The headset runs SteamOS on an Arm chip and can stream PC games wirelessly from a gaming PC using a bundled dongle.

Valve is also opening preorders for the Steam Controller, which shares the headset's thumbsticks and trackpad layout. Developers have had access to dev kits since the summer, and Valve says more than 2,000 games are already verified to run well on the headset.

The launch puts Valve in direct competition with Meta's Quest headsets during the holiday season, though Valve is positioning the Frame as an extension of a gaming PC rather than a standalone console.
